title: Another CITEM official to testify Friday as manager seeks postponement
summary: MANILA, Philippines — Another representative of the Center for International Trade Expositions and Missions (CITEM) will testify on Friday in the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Another representative of the Center for International Trade Expositions and Missions (CITEM) will testify on Friday in the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte after a department manager requested the postponement of her appearance. The court ordered this on Day 44 of Duterte’s trial, after Rowena Mendoza, CITEM Department Manager III, asked the Senate Impeachment Court also on Thursday to move her testimony to a later date.
